duplicatedLinePercent.anchor: half of SonarQube's default Sonar way gate, which fails above 3.0% duplicated lines on new code. For scale, DejaVu (Lopes et al., OOPSLA 2017, 4.5M GitHub projects and 428M files) found only 6% of JavaScript files distinct, the worst of the four languages it measured

maximumArity.anchor: below SonarSource rule S107, whose default maximum is 7 parameters

maximumCacheFanOut.anchor: well below the Coupling Between Objects limits in the literature, 9 in Microsoft's guidance and 14 in Sahraoui, Godin and Miceli

orphanCacheKeys.anchor: no industry number: a cache write naming a key no query reads is a defect, not a quantity to budget

maximumTimingDegree.anchor: no industry number exists for connascence; set from this repository's own distribution, whose worst cluster is 6
